source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the levels of ecological organization (PDF 228-230).

items: Species, zindagi ki ikai: aise jandaron ka group jin ki jismani aur genetic khasiyatein milti hain aur jo milap kar ke zarkhez bachche de sakte hain. Indus river dolphin alag species hai: Indus dolphins aapas mein nasl barhati hain lekin doosri dolphins se nahi.
Population: aik waqt aik ilaqe mein aik species ke afraad. Chitral Gol National Park ke sab markhor aik population; poore Pakistan ke markhor species hain.

Community: aik ilaqe mein rehne aur amal karne wali mukhtalif species ki sab populations, paude, janwar, phaphoond aur bacteria samet; maslan Karachi ka mangrove jangal apne darakhton, mudskippers, kekron aur sahili parindon ke saath.

Ecosystem: zinda (biotic) hisse aur be-jaan (abiotic) hisse jaise dhoop, mitti, paani aur hawa; tawanai aik taraf bahti aur ghizai ajza chakkar lagate hain. Thar registan apne saanpon, kaale hirnon aur jhaariyon aur apni garmi, khisakte teelon aur kam barish ke saath ecosystem hai.

Biome: khaas aab-o-hawa, mitti aur unchai aur un ke mutabiq dhale paudon aur janwaron wala bara ilaqa; Pakistan mein Murree aur Swat ka conifer jangal, Thal aur Thar ka registan, aur Indus darya ke nizam jaise meethe paani ke biomes.
Biosphere: sab se ooncha darja, sab biomes ka majmooa, zameen ka har woh hissa jahan zindagi hai, Arabian Sea ki gehri khaiyon se Himalaya ki oonchi chotiyon aur hawa mein kai kilometre tak.

blocks.alt: Chhe jure hue hexagon. 1. Species: aik Indus River dolphin. 2. Population: kai Indus dolphins. 3. Community: talaab mein dolphins, machhliyan aur bagla. 4. Ecosystem: suraj, badal, pahar aur darya ki wadi, energy flow aur nutrient cycling ke teeron ke saath. 5. Biome: Pakistan ka naqsha, coniferous jangal (Swat), registan (Thar) aur riverine (Indus) ilaqe. 6. Biosphere: zameen ka gola, atmosphere, lithosphere aur hydrosphere.

blocks.long_description: Panels ki ibaratein kitab wali hain (English mein): SPECIES se BIOSPHERE tak. Teer 1 se 6 tak tarteeb se jaate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is khaake mein kitab ke chhe hexagon phone par parhne ke liye do-do ki qataron mein rakhe gaye hain; teer phir bhi 1 se 6 tak usi tarteeb se jaate hain: species (aik dolphin) se population (kai dolphins), community (kai qismein), ecosystem (jandar + be-jaan mahol), biome (aab-o-hawa wala bara ilaqa) aur biosphere (poori zameen ki zindagi).

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Biosphere ko aksar 'aalami ecosystem' kehte hain: zameen ke gird patla ghilaf jahan lithosphere (khushki), hydrosphere (paani) aur atmosphere (hawa) mil kar zindagi ko sahara dete hain.

blocks.prompt: 'Pakistan ke sab markhor' species hain ya population?
blocks.explanation: Kitab poore Pakistan ke markhoron ko species aur aik ilaqe, jaise Chitral Gol, ke markhoron ko population maanti hai.

items: Species, population, community, ecosystem, biome, biosphere.
Ecosystem = community + be-jaan mahol; tawanai bahti, ghizai ajza chakkar lagate.
